lessons.titleZh: 穩定陪伴孩子的成年人

brief.meaningEn: A reliable adult who remains involved over time, helping a child feel supported and secure.
brief.meaningZh: 一名長期可靠地參與孩子生活的成年人，讓孩子感到有人支持並有安全感。
brief.grammar: Presence here means continuing personal availability and attention, not merely standing in a room.
brief.boundaryZh: 可由家長、導師或其他可信任成年人提供，不必是同一名成年人每分每秒都在場。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一次熱心探訪未必等於長期穩定的陪伴；也不代表孩子不能有其他支持。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨持續可靠的支持與一次性的幫助。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 72, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A steady adult presence helps children feel secure.

listening.promptZh: 瑪雅的支持有甚麼特點？

options.en: She showed up regularly and remembered each child’s work.
options.zh: 她定期到場，也記得每個孩子的作品。

options.en: She visited only once and forgot their names.
options.zh: 她只探訪一次，便忘了他們的名字。

options.en: She gave a gift but never spoke to the children.
options.zh: 她送了禮物，卻從不跟孩子說話。

options.en: She replaced every other adult in their lives.
options.zh: 她取代了孩子生活中的所有其他成年人。

listening.explanationZh: 定期出現和記得孩子的事，顯示可靠而持續的支持。
listening.en: At the after-school art club, Maya met the same children every Tuesday, remembered their projects and checked how they were doing after class. Maya offered a steady adult presence that helped them feel secure.
listening.zh: 在課後藝術小組，瑪雅每星期二都見同一群孩子，記得他們的作品，也在課後問候近況。瑪雅持續陪伴孩子，讓他們感到安心。

reply.promptZh: （孩子在藝術小組為何感到安心？）

options.en: They could rely on Maya each week.
options.zh: 他們每週都能依靠瑪雅。

options.en: Maya noticed how their projects were going.
options.zh: 瑪雅留意他們的作品進展。

options.en: They had a steady adult presence.
options.zh: 他們有一名成年人穩定陪伴。

options.en: The same supportive mentor kept returning.
options.zh: 同一位支持他們的導師持續回來。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出支持不是一次性的，而是持續可靠。
reply.promptEn: Why did the children feel secure at the art club?

scene.promptZh: 一名轉校學生每週與同一位輔導員短談；輔導員記得上週談過的困難，也在需要時跟進。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The counsellor provides a steady adult presence during the transition.
options.zh: 輔導員在轉校期間提供穩定的成年人陪伴。

options.en: The counsellor gave one helpful introduction but did not keep in touch.
options.zh: 輔導員作過一次有幫助的介紹，但之後沒有保持聯絡。

options.en: The weekly meetings were routine, with no attention to the student’s earlier concerns.
options.zh: 每週會面只是例行公事，沒有留意學生先前的疑慮。

scene.explanationZh: 定期短談和後續跟進呈現持續可靠的支持。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 steady 誤解為「完全不用調整」？

options.en: A reliable adult can adapt the kind of help a child needs.
options.zh: 可靠的成年人可按孩子需要調整協助方式。

options.en: Steady means giving exactly the same advice every time, even when circumstances change.
options.zh: 穩定就是不論情況如何轉變，每次都給完全相同的建議。

options.en: A mentor may stay involved while listening to new concerns.
options.zh: 導師可持續參與，同時聆聽新出現的疑慮。

contrast.explanationZh: steady 指可靠而持續，不是僵化重複同一做法。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「有位嘉賓來過學校一次，算不算 steady adult presence？」你知道學生每週仍由班主任跟進。哪句最完整？

options.en: The guest’s visit may help, but a steady adult presence comes from someone like the teacher who keeps checking in each week.
options.zh: 嘉賓探訪可能有幫助，但穩定的成年人陪伴來自班主任這類每週持續跟進的人。

options.en: The guest may have been encouraging.
options.zh: 嘉賓可能帶來鼓勵。

options.en: The teacher speaks to students every week.
options.zh: 班主任每週都與學生交談。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句尊重一次幫助，同時分清持續跟進的意義。

speaking.en: Maya offered a steady adult presence by meeting the children every week.
speaking.zh: 瑪雅每週與孩子見面，提供穩定的成年人陪伴。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出她支持孩子的頻率。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名孩子搬到另一個城市後，阿姨每逢星期日視像通話，記得孩子先前擔心的新學校問題，也會問候情況有否改善。用一至兩句英文說明這種支持。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出阿姨定期聯絡並記得孩子的疑慮；她不必住在同一城市，也不代表全天候待命。

examples.en: Even from another city, the aunt offers a steady adult presence through Sunday calls and follow-up about the new school.
examples.zh: 即使身在另一個城市，阿姨仍透過星期日通話和對新學校的跟進，提供穩定的成年人陪伴。

examples.en: Her regular video calls give the child a steady adult presence during the move, because she remembers his worries and checks what has changed.
examples.zh: 搬遷期間，阿姨定期視像通話，記得孩子的憂慮並問候情況有何變化，讓孩子得到穩定的成年人陪伴。

takeaways.en: A steady adult presence can come from a mentor who checks in consistently.
takeaways.zh: 穩定的成年人陪伴可來自持續問候的導師。

takeaways.en: One inspiring visit is helpful, but a steady adult presence takes time.
takeaways.zh: 一次鼓舞人心的探訪有幫助，但穩定的成年人陪伴需要時間。

lessons.titleEn: have both a conscience and a backbone
lessons.titleZh: 既有良知也有堅持原則的勇氣

target.pattern: \b(?:have|has|had|having) both a conscience and a backbone\b

brief.meaningEn: Combine ethical awareness of what is right with the courage to act on it under pressure.
brief.meaningZh: 既能察覺甚麼做法合乎道德，也有勇氣在壓力下依原則行事。
brief.grammar: Conscience names moral judgement; backbone is figurative firmness. The pair requires both, not just kindness or stubbornness.
brief.boundaryZh: 有良知不等於每個決定都容易；有骨氣也不等於不聽證據或拒絕妥協。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把只會同情但不行動，或只會強硬卻不顧對錯的人，都稱為兼備兩者。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出一項道德關注，以及在壓力下採取的具體正確行動。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 86, row 14; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Good leaders have both a conscience and a backbone.
sources.expression: have both a conscience and a backbone

listening.promptZh: 主管的決定兼顧了甚麼？

options.en: She noticed a risk to customers and acted despite sales pressure.
options.zh: 她留意到顧客風險，並在銷售壓力下採取行動。

options.en: She ignored the missing ingredient to protect sales.
options.zh: 她為保住銷售而無視漏列成分。

options.en: She stopped all sales without checking the label.
options.zh: 她沒有核對標籤就停止所有銷售。

options.en: She cared only about the shop’s reputation.
options.zh: 她只關心店舖聲譽。

listening.explanationZh: 察覺顧客風險是良知；頂住忙碌壓力改正錯誤則需勇氣。
listening.en: A shop supervisor found that a cake label left out a nut ingredient. Even though the weekend sale was busy, she stopped the sale and corrected the label. Her decision showed she had both a conscience and a backbone.
listening.zh: 一名店舖主管發現蛋糕標籤漏列堅果成分。雖然週末生意繁忙，她仍暫停售賣並改正標籤。她的決定顯示她既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣。

options.en: She recognised a safety problem and dealt with it.
options.zh: 她辨識安全問題並處理。

options.en: She protected customers despite commercial pressure.
options.zh: 她在商業壓力下保障顧客。

options.en: She had both a conscience and a backbone.
options.zh: 她既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣。

options.en: She made the ethical choice and stood by it.
options.zh: 她作出合乎道德的選擇，並堅持到底。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都涵蓋道德判斷和頂住壓力採取行動。
reply.promptEn: What qualities did the supervisor show?

scene.promptZh: 慈善活動負責人發現募款數字被誇大。公開更正會令活動延誤，但她核實後仍向捐款人說明。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She has both a conscience and a backbone: she checks the figures and corrects them openly.
options.zh: 她既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣：她核對數字並公開更正。

options.en: She cared about donors but planned to delay any public correction until after the event.
options.zh: 她關心捐款人，卻打算把公開更正延至活動結束後。

options.en: She acted decisively by announcing a correction before checking whether the figures were wrong.
options.zh: 她在未核實數字是否有誤前便宣布更正，表現得果斷。

scene.explanationZh: 核實數字表現道德關注，公開更正則需要勇氣。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句誤把 backbone 當作固執？

options.en: Courage can include admitting a mistake and correcting it.
options.zh: 勇氣可以包括承認錯誤並改正。

options.en: Having a backbone means refusing all evidence and never changing any decision.
options.zh: 有骨氣就是拒絕所有證據，永不改變任何決定。

options.en: A principled person can still listen carefully.
options.zh: 堅持原則的人仍可細心聆聽。

contrast.explanationZh: backbone 是按原則行事的勇氣，不是拒絕證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「主管知道標籤漏列堅果，但週末太忙，先照賣吧。」你知道顧客可能受到影響。哪句最完整？

options.en: A good supervisor has both a conscience and a backbone: she protects customers by pausing sales and fixing the label, even when the shop is busy.
options.zh: 好主管既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣：即使店舖繁忙，她仍暫停售賣並修正標籤，以保障顧客。

options.en: The label should list the nuts.
options.zh: 標籤應列出堅果。

options.en: The weekend sale is busy.
options.zh: 週末生意繁忙。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出道德風險與頂住壓力的具體行動。

speaking.en: The supervisor had both a conscience and a backbone when she corrected the cake label despite pressure.
speaking.zh: 主管在壓力下仍改正蛋糕標籤，顯示她既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出她在甚麼壓力下仍採取行動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區活動廳準備舉辦大型節目，工作人員為了方便把物資箱放在無障礙入口前。負責人發現這會妨礙輪椅使用者，儘管同事反對，她仍要求搬走箱子。用一至兩句英文評價其決定。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出無障礙通道的需要，以及負責人在同事反對下仍採取的行動；不要聲稱已有意外發生。

examples.en: The coordinator has both a conscience and a backbone: she protects wheelchair access by moving supplies despite objections from the event team.
examples.zh: 負責人既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣：儘管活動團隊反對，她仍搬走物資，保障輪椅使用者出入。

examples.en: When the team wanted to keep boxes at the entrance, she showed she had both a conscience and a backbone by insisting on a clear route for visitors.
examples.zh: 當團隊想把箱子留在入口時，她堅持為訪客保留暢通通道，顯示她既有良知，也有堅持原則的勇氣。

takeaways.en: A leader can have both a conscience and a backbone by admitting an error under pressure.
takeaways.zh: 領袖在壓力下承認錯誤，可表現出良知和堅持原則的勇氣。

takeaways.en: To have both a conscience and a backbone is to care about consequences and act on that concern.
takeaways.zh: 兼備良知和堅持原則的勇氣，就是關心後果並據此行動。
